taylor: noticed duplicate token-attribution entries after a partial redeploy... short log:

samir: can you paste repro & whether credits or attribution?

taylor: tokens attribution. repro: 1) producer writes events; 2) consumer A begins finalizing audit-window; 3) deployment causes A to restart mid-finalize; 4) consumer B takes over and finalizes overlapping window.

josh_ops: logs:
```
2026-03-02T03:21:10Z INFO finalize.window start [100..200]
2026-03-02T03:21:11Z ERROR process.term SIGTERM
2026-03-02T03:21:12Z INFO consumer.start resume at offset 100
2026-03-02T03:21:13Z INFO attribution.emit window[100..200] tx=abcd1234
```

emily: proposal: attach a handoff-epoch and owner-id to each emission; enforce sink-level dedupe by (partition, window_start, handoff_epoch). also add a compacted KV manifest with CAS to advance epoch atomically on handoff.

samir: agree. defense-in-depth: manifest CAS + idempotent sink. sink should return a clear 'stale_epoch' rejection so emitter can push to reconcile topic.

audit-bot: created ticket PLAT-1199: "epoched-handoff + sink-idempotency" and assigned to samir/emily.

taylor: action items: emily spike sink dedupe + error codes; samir spike manifest CAS perf; josh_ops draft ops retention for reconcile topic. aim RFC next week :thumbsup:
